abilities.name: Intercessor Focus
abilities.text: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to any Ballistic Skill (A) Tests to fire a ranged weapon with the PRIMARIS Keyword. The Bolt Rifle and Heavy Bolt Pistol qualify. The Heavy Bolter does not: it has no PRIMARIS keyword (Core p.217, VoA p.67).

abilities.name: Heavy Intercessor Doctrine
abilities.text: You receive Mark X Gravis armour if you don't already have it and one of the following weapons: Heavy Bolt Rifle, Heavy Bolter. You additional +Rank AP when using this weapon. Furthermore, you gain the Bolter Discipline Talent (see page 45). He chose the Heavy Bolter.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Promethean Cult
abilities.text: Forged in fire, Salamanders are masters of purging flame and blazing weapons. You may reroll Rank dice once per attack Test made using a weapon with the FIRE or MELTA Keywords. You may reroll Double Rank dice once each time you roll Determination against a damage from a source with the FIRE or MELTA Keyword. None of his weapons has FIRE or MELTA: his bolt weapons are BOLT (Core p.217, VoA p.67) and his grenades EXPLOSIVE (Core p.220), so only the Determination reroll applies, against enemy flamers and meltas.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Cunning (+1 Determination); Accomplishment Badge of Honour (+1 Influence: he risked his life to rescue mortals in peril); Goal Honour the Chapter (+1 Conviction). Determination is 7 (T 6 + 1).

talents.name: Bolter Discipline
talents.text: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains the Rapid Fire (2) Trait. If the weapon already has the Rapid Fire Trait, add +Rank to the weapon's Rapid Fire rating.

talents.name: Master Artisan
talents.text: Whenever you make an attack with one of your own weapons (i.e., any weapon with which you began the current adventure), you may re-roll up to Rank dice on the attack. He forged the Heavy Bolter himself, but every weapon he began the adventure with counts.

gear: Spare armour: Mk X Tacticus (AR 5, Powered (4)); only one suit's AR counts at a time (Core p.231)
Ballistic Appeasement Auto-Reliquary (Core p.236): clear a jammed weapon as a Free Action
Hellfire Bolt rounds (+3 ED against organic targets, +2 against inorganic, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: A Nocturnean smith who forges his own Infernus-pattern heavy bolter. He has held the front line in many Tyranid wars, which earned him the title Horde-Slayer.

objectives.text: Chapter: get the dig-site workers out alive.
Secret: keep your brothers from killing any human guardsmen.
